title: The Dragon promotion batch nine (census 900)

banner.title: The Dragon promotion batch nine - issues 17 through 18 complete
banner.provenance: The content-structure arc round twelve, the ninth rules promotion batch under the R968 format: six records promoted mechanically from their spec JSONs into content/rules/dragon/ - issues 17 and 18 complete (jou the jousting opener, wzd the Wizard With A Dog opener, f17 the box closer, psy the insanity chart opener, mkn the Sullin new spells opener, f18 the box closer), 729 model items, every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof). The batch sizing rides the raised ceiling (Curtiss, 2026-10-31): whole issue groups per round - this batch is 192398 bytes of Lua, the heaviest so far. Cumulative 50 of the walked 79-round Dragon set, 29 remaining - the halfway mark passes with this batch.
